```python
import httpx

# Create a Retry object configured to retry up to 3 times
retry = httpx.Retry(max_retries=3)

# Create an HTTPTransport with the retry policy
transport = httpx.HTTPTransport(retries=retry)

# Create an httpx Client with the configured transport
with httpx.Client(transport=transport) as client:
    response = client.get("https://www.example.com")
    print(f"Status: {response.status_code}")
```
